And with that it’s in the queue
Changed the channel name: SC - Condemn Jar Wattinree

```The resolution on the floor of the World Assembly paints a terrifying image of the nation of Jar Wattinree. The unmatched cruelty of this nation cannot be understated, from the event of Arembia discussed in the resolution to the treatment of regional animals and even the annexation of nations beyond the scope of the Pacific. The fact that Jar is still in a regional officer position in the New Pacific Order despite these crimes is a testament to the brute force of will they use to subjugate their allies and enemies alike. The World Assembly needs to take a stand against these horrific acts. The East Pacific recommends a vote FOR this condemnation.```
Changed the channel name: [Concluded] SC - Condemn Jar Wattinree
